requirements.requirement: Original context cancellation/deadline remains binding even if caller supplies a fresh context; SQL time cannot roll back or reach original until.

requirements.requirement: All deployment guard callbacks precede independent worker/config/evidence/tombstone/absent-key rechecks and last clock/cancel checks.
requirements.proof: Late callback mutations fail; no callback/provider/transaction or lock acquisition occurs after independent checks.
